title: Hilton and Sun Group Expand Strategic Partnership to 10 Hotels and More Than 5,000 Rooms Across Vietnam
summary: Hilton announced four new hotel agreements in Phu Quoc with longstanding partner Sun Group, expanding their strategic partnership across Vietnam.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


- **New hotel agreements in Phu Quoc will add nearly 2,400 rooms across three properties on Hon Thom Island and one in the Red Soil District** .
- **Signia Hilton to make its South East Asia debut, while Canopy Hotels and Tempo by Hilton will enter Vietnam for the first time** .
- **Expanded partnership will encompass eight hotels across eight distinct Hilton brands in Phu Quoc, including the existing La Festa Phu Quoc, Curio Collection by Hilton** .


**SINGAPORE** –[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/?_gl=1*13s1pxv*_gcl_au*MjYwNjU0Njk5LjE3NTQwMzcxMDMuMTY1OTU0ODQ3OC4xNzU0Mjg1NzQ1LjE3NTQyODU3NDU.) (Nasdaq: HLT) today announced four new hotel agreements in Phu Quoc with longstanding partner Sun Group, expanding their strategic partnership to 10 hotels spanning nine Hilton brands and more than 5,000 rooms across Vietnam. The four signings will add a combined 2,369 rooms, with three hotels planned for Hon Thom Island under the[Signia Hilton](https://stories.hilton.com/apac/brands/signia-by-hilton) ,[Canopy Hotels](https://stories.hilton.com/apac/brands/canopy-by-hilton) and[Tapestry Collection by Hilton](https://stories.hilton.com/apac/brands/tapestry-collection) brands, and one under[Tempo by Hilton](https://stories.hilton.com/apac/brands/tempo-by-hilton) in the Red Soil District on Phu Quoc's main island.


The agreements will pave the way for Signia Hilton's debut in South East Asia and the first hotels in Vietnam for Canopy Hotels and Tempo by Hilton. They also build on three[previously announced](https://stories.hilton.com/apac/releases/hilton-and-sun-group-deepen-strategic-partnership-to-transform-vietnams-hospitality-landscape) projects in Phu Quoc – Conrad Phu Quoc, Hilton Phu Quoc and DoubleTree by Hilton Phu Quoc – bringing Hilton's development pipeline on the island to seven hotels. Hilton’s expanded Phu Quoc portfolio will include those seven hotels and[La Festa Phu Quoc, Curio Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/pqcpqqq-la-festa-phu-quoc/) , which is already welcoming guests in Sunset Town. In all, the eight hotels will represent eight distinct brands, offering travelers a broad choice of luxury, lifestyle and full-service hospitality experiences.


Beyond Phu Quoc, the Hilton–Sun Group partnership also includes an[LXR Hotels & Resorts](https://stories.hilton.com/apac/brands/lxr-hotels) property under development in Da Nang and[Hilton Quang Hanh Onsen Resort](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/vdohohi-hilton-quang-hanh-onsen-resort/) in Quang Ninh, which opened in February 2026.


The expansion comes as Phu Quoc prepares to host the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting in 2027. Significant investment in accommodation, entertainment and transport infrastructure is strengthening the island’s appeal to international leisure and business travelers and supporting its growth as a tourism destination beyond the event.


“Vietnam is fast emerging as one of Asia Pacific’s most exciting growth markets, underpinned by strong travel demand and rising international appeal,” said Alan Watts, president, Asia Pacific, Hilton. “As appetite for distinctive experience-led travel accelerates, we see tremendous potential for Phu Quoc to establish itself among Asia’s leading leisure destinations. We are thrilled to deepen our steadfast collaboration with Sun Group, introduce four more of our world-class brands to the vibrant island of Phu Quoc, and welcome even more travelers to experience our signature hospitality in this remarkable locale.”


“Our expanded partnership with Hilton reflects our long-term commitment to developing Phu Quoc as an international tourism destination. As we continue to invest in the island's hospitality, entertainment and supporting infrastructure, the addition of four Hilton brands will give visitors a wider choice of places to stay. Together, we look forward to creating destinations that serve the growing needs of travelers while contributing to Phu Quoc's development well beyond APEC 2027,” said Mr. Dang Minh Truong, chairman of the board of directors, Sun Group.


## **Three New Hotels to Broaden Luxury and Lifestyle Offerings on Hon Thom Island**


Expected to open in the fourth quarter of 2028, **Signia Hilton Phu Quoc Thom Island** , **Canopy by Hilton Phu Quoc Thom Island** and **Tapestry Collection by Hilton Phu Quoc Thom Island** will add over 1,600 rooms to Hon Thom Paradise Island, the largest island in the An Thoi archipelago off Phu Quoc's southern coast. The three properties will be situated within an emerging tourism and entertainment destination offering resort stays, wellness and leisure experiences.


The 933-room **Signia Hilton Phu Quoc Thom Island** will mark the luxury brand's entry into South East Asia, bringing its distinctive approach to hospitality to a resort setting. Combining destination-driven dining, innovative wellness experiences, vibrant gathering spaces and intuitive service that help guests connect, recharge and make the most of their stay, the hotel will welcome leisure travelers and host meetings, events and celebrations. The signing adds to Signia Hilton's growing portfolio, with planned openings in Naples, Florida; Tainan; and Jaipur in 2027, as the brand advances towards its ambition of doubling its global portfolio by 2028.


Alongside it, the 289-room **Canopy by Hilton Phu Quoc Thom Island** will introduce the brand's locally inspired boutique hospitality experience to Vietnam. Known for its inviting design, considered food and beverage offerings and intentionally crafted touchpoints, Canopy Hotels create opportunities for guests to connect with the character and culture of their surroundings. The signing follows the brand's[South East Asia debut with Canopy Bangkok Sukhumvit](https://stories.hilton.com/apac/releases/canopy-bangkok-sukhumvit-debuts-in-south-east-asia) in August 2026, further expanding its presence in the region.


The 444-room **Tapestry Collection by Hilton Phu Quoc Thom Island** will bring the collection's individually vibrant approach to hospitality to Hon Thom. Each Tapestry Collection hotel tells an original story through its design, décor and artwork, complemented by locally inspired food and beverage experiences that encourage guests to explore their surroundings. The signing will further expand the collection's presence in Vietnam, following its debut in the country with the[opening of NHAAN Resort & Spa Hoi An, Tapestry Collection by Hilton](https://stories.hilton.com/apac/releases/tapestry-collection-by-hilton-debuts-in-vietnam-with-nhaan-resort-spa-hoi-an) in August 2026.


The hotels will join Hon Thom's growing tourism and entertainment precinct, home to attractions including Sun World Hon Thom, Aquatopia Water Park and the Hon Thom Cable Car, which connects the island to Sunset Town and offers panoramic views of the surrounding archipelago.


## **Tempo by Hilton to Enter Vietnam in Phu Quoc's Red Soil District**


Expected to open in late 2029, the 703-room **Tempo by Hilton Phu Quoc Red Soil** will introduce Hilton’s contemporary lifestyle brand to Vietnam. The hotel will be located along Ruby Beach in Phu Quoc’s Red Soil District. It will form part of a major hospitality and events precinct on the island's southern coast, where Hilton and Sun Group are also developing the previously announced Conrad Phu Quoc, Hilton Phu Quoc and DoubleTree by Hilton Phu Quoc hotels.


[Tempo by Hilton](https://stories.hilton.com/brands/tempo-by-hilton) is a stylish, upscale lifestyle brand designed for ambitious travelers looking to maintain a sense of balance and momentum. The brand brings together purposefully designed guest rooms, buzzy and inviting public spaces, amenities centered on mindful living and balanced food and beverage offerings. The Phu Quoc signing builds on Tempo by Hilton's growing momentum in Asia Pacific, following the brand's[first signings in China](https://stories.hilton.com/apac/releases/tempo-by-hilton-to-debut-in-asia-pacific-first-signings-in-china) across destinations including Xiamen, Beijing, Chengdu and Jiaxing, as well as its[recent signing in Phuket, Thailand](https://stories.hilton.com/apac/releases/tempo-by-hilton-phuket-signing) . The brand is also entering continental Europe and the UK, with its first projects in[Germany](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/tempo-by-hilton-lifestyle-brand-to-debut-in-germany-with-hotel-at-munich-arena) and[Northern Ireland](https://stories.hilton.com/emea/releases/belfast-set-to-welcome-europes-first-tempo-by-hilton-hotel) .


## **Strengthening Hilton's Presence in Vietnam**


Hilton currently operates 25 hotels in Vietnam, its third-largest portfolio in South East Asia. With the addition of the four newly signed properties, Hilton is on track to more than double its estate in Vietnam with another 26 hotels under development. The agreements also strengthen Hilton’s growth in Asia Pacific with more than 200 trading luxury and lifestyle hotels in the region and 86 under development, putting the company on track to exceed its[target of 250 luxury and lifestyle properties](https://stories.hilton.com/apac/releases/hilton-to-exceed-250-luxury-and-lifestyle-hotels-in-asia-pacific) .


All four hotels will participate in[Hilton Honors](https://www.hilton.com/en/hilton-honors/?_gl=1*1m6vaun*_gcl_aw*R0NMLjE3Nzg1NTMxMzUuQ2owS0NRandfSVhRQmhDa0FSSXNBRHFFTGJJSElGYUttMXQ1Z25GT3hQMVJNcnBVTWs0aDlKODJqdkZSdldtTFdDMUZrYTMwX0x6aHpja2FBdGFwRUFMd193Y0I.*_gcl_dc*R0NMLjE3Nzg1NTMxMzUuQ2owS0NRandfSVhRQmhDa0FSSXNBRHFFTGJJSElGYUttMXQ1Z25GT3hQMVJNcnBVTWs0aDlKODJqdkZSdldtTFdDMUZrYTMwX0x6aHpja2FBdGFwRUFMd193Y0I.*_gcl_au*MjA2MzY1NDcxMi4xNzc2OTE4NDM3LjExNzA0MTIzMTMuMTc4MDAyMDA3OS4xNzgwMDIwMDc4) , the award-winning guest loyalty program for Hilton’s 28 distinct hotel brands. Hilton Honors members who book directly through preferred Hilton channels have access to instant benefits, including member discounts, free standard Wi-Fi and the Hilton Honors mobile app.


##### **FAQ: Hilton and Sun Group's Expanded Partnership in Vietnam**


Hilton announced four new hotel agreements with Sun Group in Phu Quoc, adding 2,369 rooms across Signia Hilton Phu Quoc Thom Island, Canopy by Hilton Phu Quoc Thom Island, Tapestry Collection by Hilton Phu Quoc Thom Island and Tempo by Hilton Phu Quoc Red Soil. Three hotels will be located on Hon Thom Island and one in the Red Soil District.


The latest agreements will bring the Hilton–Sun Group partnership to 10 hotels spanning nine Hilton brands and more than 5,000 rooms across Vietnam. In Phu Quoc, the four new hotels join three previously announced developments, bringing Hilton's pipeline on the island to seven hotels, alongside the existing La Festa Phu Quoc, Curio Collection by Hilton.


Signia Hilton will make its South East Asia debut with Signia Hilton Phu Quoc Thom Island. Canopy Hotels and Tempo by Hilton will also enter Vietnam for the first time, while Tapestry Collection by Hilton will expand its existing presence in the country.


Signia Hilton Phu Quoc Thom Island, Canopy by Hilton Phu Quoc Thom Island and Tapestry Collection by Hilton Phu Quoc Thom Island will be located on Hon Thom Paradise Island, part of the An Thoi archipelago off Phu Quoc's southern coast. Tempo by Hilton Phu Quoc Red Soil will be situated in the Red Soil District on Phu Quoc's main island.


Signia Hilton Phu Quoc Thom Island, Canopy by Hilton Phu Quoc Thom Island and Tapestry Collection by Hilton Phu Quoc Thom Island are expected to open in the fourth quarter of 2028. Tempo by Hilton Phu Quoc Red Soil is expected to open in late 2029.

## About Sun Group


Founded in 2007, Sun Group is one of Vietnam’s leading private business groups and a pioneer in Vietnamese tourism. The Group has unlocked the potential of numerous destinations across the north, center and south of Vietnam, turning them into internationally recognized landmarks, most notably Ba Na Hills in Da Nang, Fansipan in Sa Pa and Phu Quoc. Each destination brings together the Group’s Sun World entertainment brand, world-class hotels and resorts, and signature live performances.


This proven track record has earned the trust of the Vietnamese Government to deliver projects of national importance, including key infrastructure in Phu Quoc for Vietnam’s hosting of APEC 2027.


Sun Group’s strategic investments also span real estate, film and the performing arts, and healthcare, supported by capabilities in finance, construction and digital technology. Its wider portfolio includes infrastructure and aviation. In aviation, the Group is building a Phu Quoc-centered hub-and-spoke network through its airport investments, Sun PhuQuoc Airways and Sun Air.
